title: Kennewick v3 editorial local-service journey
purpose: Section-by-section geometry and hierarchy authority for implementation; generated photographic pixels are never production assets.
brandAuthority: Current It's A Keeper Photography design system
Approved Seniors, Newborn, and Family EditorialHero pattern
referencePolicy: The supplied inspiration contributes layout geometry, scale, overlap, and pacing only; its branding, colors, copy, decoration, and imagery are excluded.
productionImagePolicy: Use only real repository photographs or verified, locally optimized images from the Kennewick Drive folders. Preserve all production photographs and do not infer location or session diversity from generated previews.

contentContract.copy: Approved repository copy is verbatim authority; text in previews is illustrative when abbreviated.
h2Order: Ten Minutes From My Front Door
If Light and Airy Isn't What You Pictured
contentContract.heroAction: Native button scrolling to and focusing the final invitation
contentContract.galleryGate: Exactly five verified safe Kennewick sessions, unique image paths and literal alt text; zero gallery anchors; Benton City excluded
contentContract.galleryAuthorization: Production Page Feedback addendum approved 2026-08-09; never fabricate a sixth session

previews.promptIntent: Match the established EditorialHero of the Seniors, Newborn, and Family pages with a full-bleed golden photograph, centered two-line H1, intro, outlined scroll button, two edge prints, paper edge, and no script phrase.
previews.geometry: Full viewport-width hero; centered copy stack; supporting prints enter from opposite lateral edges; paper transition closes the section.

previews.promptIntent: Pair Lisa's existing portrait in a tall left arch with one vertical rule and the exact proximity heading and approved copy on the right.
previews.geometry: Airy two-column Ivory field; image occupies the left editorial third; hairline separates it from a compact right copy column.

previews.promptIntent: Keep the light-and-airy contrast copy dominant on the left and create one restrained right-side collage from a framed landscape and a smaller overlapping portrait.
previews.geometry: Asymmetric two-column section; dominant landscape sits right; one smaller portrait crosses its lower edge; overlap dissolves on mobile.

previews.promptIntent: Make What Works Well in Kennewick a confident text-led tonal field with an overscale left heading and three readable right-side copy blocks separated by rules.
previews.geometry: Broad flat section; heading anchors the left grid; three stacked prose blocks form the right ledger; no required image.

previews.promptIntent: Present the five services as full-width ledger links and cross the directory with one tall verified photograph, without converting rows into cards; preview numbering is decorative, not binding.
previews.geometry: Heading and five ruled rows own most of the grid; one tall portrait anchors the opposite side and supplies the sole directory signature gesture.

previews.promptIntent: Use a deep Walnut field, left-side Kennewick Questions heading, and four native disclosure rows at right with one answer shown to establish rhythm.
previews.geometry: Two-column dark ledger; fixed visual heading anchor at left; ruled disclosure stack occupies the wider right column.

previews.promptIntent: Close with a full-bleed verified Kennewick photograph, controlled dark wash, exact final heading and copy, and one centered Contact CTA.
previews.geometry: Full-width closing field; centered compact content stack; single CTA; no secondary conversion path.
